stops.title: Nhwɛmu no
stops.caption: Ahɔhoɔ foforɔ, wɔn a wɔnni kuo mu, ne berɛ a atwam.
stops.speech: Nkɔdi Akyi wɔ nhwɛmu mmiɛnsa: ahɔhoɔ foforɔ a obiara ne wɔn nkasaeɛ, wɔn a wɔnni kuo biara mu, ne deɛ berɛ atwam.

stops.title: Kyerɛw bi
stops.caption: Hwan, ɛkwan bɛn, ne deɛ ɛdi hɔ.
stops.speech: Sɛ wokyerɛw nkɔdi akyi a, ɛkora hwan na ɔfrɛeɛ, ɛkwan bɛn so, deɛ ɛsiiɛ, ne deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ ɛdi hɔ. Wobɛtumi ahyɛ no asɛm nso.
